checks.text: On first load the page shows the heading "Connect Four", the text "Player 1's turn", and the score line "Score: 0".
Clicking the button with visible label "Drop in column 4" places a red disc in the bottom row of column 4; the text changes to "Player 2's turn" and the score line remains "Score: 0".
After Player 1 drops in column 4, Player 2 drops in column 4, Player 1 drops in column 5, and Player 2 drops in column 5, the text shows "Player 1's turn" and no winner message is visible.
Continuing from A3, Player 1 drops in column 6 and Player 2 drops in column 6; the text changes to "Player 1's turn" and no winner message is visible.
Continuing from A4, Player 1 drops in column 7; the text changes to "Player 1 wins" and the score line updates to "Score: 1".
After a win is declared, clicking the button "Restart" clears the board, resets the text to "Player 1's turn", and keeps the score line at "Score: 1".
After a win is declared, clicking the button "New game" clears the board, resets the text to "Player 1's turn", and resets the score line to "Score: 0".
With the board full (all 42 cells occupied) and no winner, the text shows "Draw" and the score line remains unchanged.
Reload keeps the score: after achieving "Score: 1" and reloading the page, the score line still shows "Score: 1" and the board is cleared with the text "Player 1's turn".
